about: A migration run started at 15:30 is still open at migrating, batch 1, round 0. The writer has since added a line, so there is new work. A second start --kind migration at 17:00 refuses: exit 1, and the stderr line points the writer to recover. Nothing changes: run-state.json still holds the 15:30 run, its folder is untouched, and no snapshot is saved for the 17:00 run. The stderr check is only the word "recover", as in case 06.
